prompt:
Edit image 1, the grey wheat guide, into ONE flat ripe wheat field sprite. Use case: precise-object-edit. Request output 1024x1024 pixels, RGBA PNG, transparent background. Keep the full guide canvas and exact framing: large empty upper area; field stays near bottom, NOT centred in the canvas and NOT enlarged to fill it. Guide is the edit target. Image 2 theme-town-growth is style reference for pastoral industry, folk warmth and quiet ambition. Images 3 farm, 4 cargo-wheat, 5 props-oil-v2 are hue, scale and finish references only; do not copy their blocky pixel edges or any objects from them.
GEOMETRY: 2:1 orthographic isometric, 64x32 game px per tile, 8 canvas px per game px. Tile centre/anchor (512,832). Tile diamond top (512,704), right (768,832), bottom (512,960), left (256,832). Point at tile offset (x,y)=(512+256*(x-y),832+128*(x+y)). Tile x is NW to SE and tile y NE to SW. NE upper-right edge, SE lower-right, SW lower-left, NW upper-left. Field flat patch within abs(x)<=0.42 and abs(y)<=0.42, patch corners (512,724),(727,832),(512,940),(297,832). Soft irregular edge. SE/SW wander inward/outward by up to 0.04 tile, NE/NW only inward by up to 0.04 tile, keeping standing ears within tile. NOTHING outside tile diamond. Replace the grey patch and row lines with painted material and REMOVE diamond outline and all guide marks.
ROWS: about nine parallel crop bands, following guide's diagonal lines along tile y, rising to upper right (direction from (256,832) to (512,704)), parallel to NW and SE edges. Crop rows occupy 4 game px of every 6, bare furrow 2; crop twice width of furrow. Low ears rise no more than 2 game px =16 canvas px above ground; field looks like a flat patterned crop patch, no thick slab or raised platform. Tiny grouped ear hints, not tall individual stalks.
MATERIAL: ripe wheat golds #D6B256 #E8C468 #BC9846. Dry soil furrows #C6B488 darkened about a quarter (#958766). One light upper left: row tops lightest, lower-right sides darker. Broad colour clusters, only three or four shades per material, smooth painted contours, restrained game-sprite finish, no per-pixel noise, no stair-stepped pixel edges. Supporting palette forest #294638, moss #78804C, oat #E4D5B5, limestone #BCA98B, slate #626B6C, water #477B82, copper #A36B42.
VARIANT wheat-0: all ripe gold, distinct gently uneven crop clusters, soft irregular perimeter. Paint this single asset independently.
EXCLUDE fences, barn, standing sheaves, haystacks, people, animals, vehicles, shadows, grass or ground outside patch, text, borders, glow. Fully transparent alpha 0 outside patch, soft partial-alpha fringe allowed. Deliver one picture only.
